title: School Kit Distribution – ZPHS Shamshabad
summary: Notebooks, uniforms, and stationery kits distributed to 210 government school students.
description: At the start of the academic year, Prayas Seva distributed school kits — notebooks, uniforms, geometry boxes, and stationery — to 210 students across grades 1 to 8 at ZPHS Shamshabad. Kits were funded through individual donor sponsorships of ₹750 per child. Teachers and the school management committee helped identify students most in need ahead of the distribution day.
